contactSheetLayout: Assignment order, five columns. Each cell shows 96px and 80px.

provenance.export: Center-sampled nearest-neighbor PNG export; threshold the generated alpha at 128 for hard pixel edges, set fully transparent pixels to zero RGBA.
provenance.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one 96×96 transparent pixel-art portrait sprite for an American campaign strategy game. Input image is the approved style, crop, head scale, outline and lighting reference. Replace the person and outfit with an entirely different, original fictional adult. Retain only the centered upper-bust framing and real 1990s handheld pixel-art treatment. Upper-left key light, coherent dark blue-navy contour, square chunky pixel clusters, hard stepped shadows, a compact warm-neutral palette with muted teal and copper accents. Flat areas should be visibly grouped, not noisy or photoreal. Face unobscured and readable at 80 pixels. Top of head near the top with a small transparent margin, shoulders and bust anchored at the bottom, clear transparent side padding. Work on a true 96-pixel logical grid and preserve crisp edges. Transparent empty canvas. No card frame, text, lettering, logo, lettering-like details, watermark, microphone, prop inherited from the reference, named person or celebrity likeness. Only one person, no grid, no extra view. Character: one anonymous fictional campaign office adult, a middle-aged man with a warm tan complexion, short salt-and-pepper curly hair, long friendly face, and warm restrained expression. A simple dark muted burgundy office blazer, pale ivory open-collar shirt, no tie, no jewelry, no props, no badges or insignia. An everyday campaign-office colleague with a distinct facial silhouette, unrelated to the sample character or any politician.
